hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then gitstatus=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null); jq -n --arg b "$branch" --arg s "$gitstatus" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: ("Git branch: " + $b + (if $s == "" then " (clean)" else "\nGit status:\n" + $s end))}}'; fi

today=$(date "+%A, %B %d %Y"); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then gitstatus=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$gitstatus" ]; then n=$(echo "$gitstatus" | wc -l); msg="$today — on branch $branch ($n files changed)"; else msg="$today — on branch $branch (clean)"; fi; else msg="$today"; fi; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{systemMessage: $m}'
